title: Joey Porter Jr. will play for Cowboys, who elevate two DBs off practice squad

sources.title: Joey Porter Jr. will play for Cowboys, who elevate two DBs off practice squad
sources.description: The Cowboys elevated defensive backs Reddy Steward and Juanyeh Thomas from the practice squad to the active roster for Sunday's game against the Texans.
